source_behavior.action: When an owned WordPress site is selected, expose the Full user management action and navigate to /sites/{selectedSiteId}/users.
source_behavior.external_effect: Navigation only; the control does not mutate WordPress or application state.

laravel_adaptation.destination_behavior: The guarded Laravel route re-resolves the tenant-scoped Site, binds canonical_site_id, then redirects to the WordPress users workspace with the site query.

runtime_path: authenticated tenant bootstrap resolves FrontendContext and the server-owned active_site
the wp-users workspace capability requires sites.view, users.read connector scope, and the authoritative wp-users API contract
the control additionally requires tenant.view because the canonical destination route requires tenant.view and sites.view
the active site id must be a positive safe integer and must match both server-advertised Site Details and WordPress Users API paths
navigation uses the active tenant slug from FrontendContext and the server-bound active site only
the canonical destination route re-resolves the Site under the active tenant before rebinding the session
no HTTP request is fired by the control itself and no success state is synthesized

authorization_and_isolation.session: required by tenant bootstrap and canonical destination
authorization_and_isolation.site_source: server-resolved FrontendContext.active_site plus exact API binding
authorization_and_isolation.missing_sites_view: 403 on the canonical destination and no rendered control

proof: exact Site Details and WordPress Users API bindings

terminality.reason: The source Full user management navigation is represented by a real Laravel control that is exposed only for an authoritative tenant-bound active WordPress site and routes through the existing guarded site-users binding without performing or fabricating a mutation.
